About this Event

That friend you keep saying “we need to meet soon” to? November 20. Lock it in. 🫶
HIGH ON BOLLY PRESENTS

BOLLYWOOD FRIENDSGIVING 💖📍 OPAL • MOUNTAIN VIEW
🗓 FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 20 | 9:30 PM–2 AM
One minute you’re singing every word to a Bollywood favourite. 
Next, the DJ drops EDM and your whole group goes off. Add Top 40 hits, some of the Bay Area’s best DJs, and you’ve got everyone’s kind of night. 🔥

Dress up for OPAL, the upscale nightclub bringing fresh energy to nightlife in downtown Mountain View, right in the heart of the Bay Area.
We’re bringing that festival feeling inside—friendship bands, fun accessories, and people ready to meet their next favourite people.

Bring your crew, your best friend, or come solo and get adopted by one. Make a few bands, bring extras, and trade with someone new. Get your tickets. The reunion finally has a date. 💃

GET READY FOR AN EPIC BOLLYWOOD PARTY! BRING YOUR FRIENDS AND GO LIT 🔥

This is the ultimate desi party you won't want to miss!
Age Restriction: 21+ 🛑 (Please bring a valid form of ID - State issued ID/Driver License or Passport) No photocopies or digital ids will work. Club is Really strict about this🛑
*NO REFUNDS*

An immersive Bollywood music experience.A diverse playlist featuring the latest Hindi chart-toppers.A fusion of Hindi top 40, hip hop, Punjabi and TikTok trends.An elegant and lively ambiance perfect for dancing the night away.A chance to connect with like-minded Bollywood music enthusiasts of all gender and age group.
